name: CRITICAL WARNING: Airport Hudson News Trail Mixes (Raw Almonds, Cashews & Stricture Hazard)
whyItWorks: EMERGENCY CLINICAL OBSTRUCTION HAZARD: Bags of mixed raw almonds, cashews, dried cranberries, and raisins. Chewed nut shards are razor-sharp and pass largely intact, forming dense phytobezoars that can wedge in strictures at 35,000 feet—an in-flight medical emergency.
prepOrOrderInstructions: NEVER consume whole nut trail mixes while traveling with Crohn's or strictures. Choose smooth nut butters or hard-boiled eggs.
